app.title: Show HN: 1080p is 920px tall – 1k real browser viewports
app.author: zenpe
app.description: A publicly available CSV/JSON dataset of real browser viewport sizes, including width, height, device type, and user‑agent information collected from real users.
proposed_tests: Download the CSV and verify header fields match expected schema.
Load the dataset into pandas, compute distribution of viewport widths and heights, ensure no negative values.
Cross‑check a random sample of user‑agent strings against a public parser (e.g., ua-parser) to validate correctness.
Generate a simple bar chart of viewport width frequency and save to PNG to ensure rendering.
